Dream 2026-11-22 linked 5 vignettes from 3 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-30 · retells · "How will packages get distributed? They need registry/directory too." (Vignette 2026-10-30: packages need a registry or directory too)
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "Packages once created should be shared by different groups. They will subscribe to it and get updates." (Vignette 2026-10-30: packages and repositories are used in opposite directions)
- 2026-11-04 · retells · "An essay should be able to find a list of published packages and install what is needed." (An essay finds published packages and installs what it needs (2026-11-04))
- 2026-11-11 · touches · "Such a package is refined at its source and reaches a repository by upgrade." (No moving out of a local copy of a package (2026-11-11))
- 2026-11-11 · touches · "We want to be able to safely refine packages." (Refine packages safely (2026-11-11))
